title: Choosing among sign categories
description: You can compare a two-branch if with a three-way cond.

steps.description: sign uses if to choose between two symbols. You get negative for a value below zero and non-negative otherwise.
classify tests for a negative number, then zero, then uses else for a positive number. Each branch returns a quoted symbol.

steps.question: Which symbol does classify return for each value in (-3 0 7)?
steps.answer: It returns negative for -3, zero for 0 and positive for 7.

steps.description: map calls classify on each list element. You see (negative zero positive) as the result.
